cards.actionEffect: Reveal a hidden artifact <sprite name="artifact"> on a visible hex.

cards.name: Thorondir
cards.quote: The tide is Gondor's road, and I have kept its watch through darker nights than this.
cards.actionEffect: Build a port <sprite name="port"> on a controlled settlement that lacks one.

cards.name: Thrain
cards.quote: In the dark tunnels of Erebor, I found my fate entwined with shadows and gold.
cards.actionEffect: Gain 3 Gold <sprite name="gold">.

cards.name: Thranduil
cards.quote: The Elvenking wears pride like a crown of winter leaves, and the forest knows him.
cards.actionEffect: Recruit 3 ar <sprite name="ar"> to a controlled army.

cards.name: Thror
cards.quote: The mountain does not forget its king, even when the king has forgotten the mountain.
cards.actionEffect: Gain 3 Gold <sprite name="gold">.

cards.name: Tom Bombadil
cards.quote: In the greenwood, laughter is a shield more sure than iron.
cards.actionEffect: Clear Fear <sprite name="fear"> from all controlled characters.

cards.name: Treebeard
cards.quote: Treebeard remembers the young world, and speaks slowly of it.
cards.actionEffect: Recruit 3 hi <sprite name="hi"> to a controlled army.

cards.name: Tros Hesnef
cards.quote: Wisdom guides my blade, and courage fuels my heart in this relentless tide.
cards.actionEffect: Recruit 2 lc <sprite name="lc"> to a controlled army.

cards.name: Ugluk
cards.quote: To battle! The scent of blood drives us ever onward!
cards.actionEffect: Recruit 2 hi <sprite name="hi"> to a controlled army.

cards.name: Urzahil
cards.quote: In the shadows of the mountains, my true strength will reveal itself.
cards.actionEffect: Recruit 2 ma <sprite name="ma"> to a controlled army.

cards.name: Uvatha
cards.quote: In the shadow of the Dark Lord, I carve my path through fear and flame.
cards.actionEffect: Recruit 3 lc <sprite name="lc"> to a controlled army.

cards.name: Vardun
cards.quote: Wine follows the current in peace; in war, my oars carry sharper tribute.
cards.actionEffect: Build a port <sprite name="port"> on a controlled settlement that lacks one.

cards.name: Voteli
cards.quote: Voteli has looked on darkness and not bowed.
cards.actionEffect: Reveal hexes in radius 2 around all controlled characters.

cards.name: Vulmek
cards.quote: Nurumurl taught me that the desert only respects what it cannot kill.
cards.actionEffect: Recruit 2 lc <sprite name="lc"> to a controlled army.

cards.name: Waulfa
cards.quote: Strength of the earth flows through my veins; I will not falter.
cards.actionEffect: Recruit 2 lc <sprite name="lc"> to a controlled army.

cards.name: Will Whitfoot
cards.quote: They locked the Mayor away, but they could not lock away what the office stood for.
cards.actionEffect: Increase loyalty <sprite name="loyalty"> by 20 on a random controlled settlement.
